name: How long does the custom kitchen cabinetry design and installation process typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the custom kitchen cabinetry design and installation process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The custom kitchen cabinetry process typically involves several stages: initial consultation, design finalization, cabinet fabrication, and installation. Depending on the complexity, material selection, and project scope, the entire process can range from 8 to 16 weeks. Factors like special order materials or intricate custom features can extend this timeline. To help streamline the process, having a clear idea of your aesthetic preferences and functional requirements, such as specific storage needs or appliance dimensions, before our initial consultation can significantly expedite the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The custom cabinetry process, from design to installation, usually takes 8 to 16 weeks, varying with complexity and material choices.
